messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — customer ACME reported their free-trial credits didn't apply when they redeemed the campaign code yesterday. They think it charged them instead of granting the trial.
kevin_billing: Oof. Do we have the promo ID? I can pull ledger entries.
maria_cs: Promo ID P-2024-Q4-ACME. They used code ACME-TRIAL-24 at 10:12 UTC.
alex_prod: Quick question — is this the campaign that had a redemption_limit scope set to 'per_customer' instead of 'global'? I remember a template change.
maria_cs: Not sure, I only saw the UI form screenshot the customer sent. Screenshot shows "redemption_limit: 1" and start/end dates look fine but their time zone is PST.
lia_eng: I'll check config and server logs. Repro steps requested: what API call did they use to apply the code?
maria_cs: They called our REST apply endpoint via frontend:
```
POST /v1/promotions/apply
{
  "code": "ACME-TRIAL-24",
  "account_id": "acct_43xx",
  "timestamp": "2024-11-12T10:12:05Z"
}
```
kevin_billing: I looked up acct_43xx — there is a charge for a month of Dedicated usage at 10:13 UTC. No credit line adjustment. Ledger shows promo not applied.
lia_eng: Checking runtime logs for that promo id... find an error about overlapping windows with timezone offset. Log snippet: 
```
WARN promotions: campaign P-2024-Q4-ACME start>now mismatch for tz America/Los_Angeles, computed_start=2024-11-12T17:00:00Z
INFO promotions: redemption limit scope=per_customer
```
lia_eng: Hypothesis: Campaign start/end set in local timezone in UI but stored as UTC without conversion, so frontend thought it was live, backend rejected because computed_start was in the future.
alex_prod: If backend rejected as "not active" we should have returned 400 with code INACTIVE_PROMO. What did the API return to the client?
maria_cs: Customer pasted frontend toast: "Promo failed to apply — try again." No explicit API error. They said the UI showed success but they still got charged.
lia_eng: That smells like race: UI flow called apply, got transient 500/timeout, UI retried locally and created a charge before confirming promo. Need full request/response traces.
kevin_billing: Can we reconcile by granting trial credits retroactively? Customer is asking for credit for the month. I'll prepare a one-time adjustment but prefer engineering fix first.
lia_eng: Repro steps for me: 1) Create campaign with start date = 2024-11-12 00:00 in PDT via UI. 2) Inspect DB stored start_ts and API validation. 3) Call /promotions/apply with account that hasn't used a code. Observe response code and any race.
kevin_billing: For immediate remediation: I can add a manual credit and mark as refunded. Approving now pending cs/ops signoff.
maria_cs: Please do, customer is annoyed. I'll inform them we are investigating and will refund if confirmed. :pray:
alex_prod: Engineering ask: lia, can you also verify redemption_limit semantics? If scope is per_customer and we mistakenly set a per-customer limit zero or overflow, that could allow apply to silently skip.
lia_eng: Will check redemption table. Also adding tracing to apply path to avoid swallowing upstream errors into a "soft success" in UI.
kevin_billing: Billing action: manual credit + note referencing thread 1790456789. I'll attach evidence after I post adjustment.
maria_cs: Thanks team. CS follow-up plan: 1) refund/credit immediate, 2) explain root cause and ETA for fix, 3) offer extra trial week.
lia_eng: ETA: quick patch for timezone normalization and stricter apply error on prod by EOD, longer fix for validation hardening in two days.
kevin_billing: Done: issued credit txn ct_98765 for acct_43xx, amount $199. Note attached.
maria_cs: I'll ping customer and close once they confirm.
alex_prod: Filing a postmortem ticket and adding test that creates promos in different TZs. Link will go in this thread soon. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Automated alert: promo P-2024-Q4-ACME created with manual override; flagged for review.
maria_cs: Closing loop — customer confirmed credit applied and appreciated the quick turnaround. I'll leave this open until lia confirms the rollback/fix deploy.
lia_eng: Patch deployed to staging, CL scheduled for prod in 45m. Will update once live.
maria_cs: Great, thanks everyone.
